blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hallucination research in low-resource languages fragments easily: each newly named failure mode prompts its own dataset, spending scarce annotators on incomparable resources. We argue for consolidation and test it at community scale. Alikbachan is a Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark stratified along three crossed axes: a human-validated cultural-distance band, six task types, and a five-family, 32-mode hallucination taxonomy. It comprises a harvested 2,516-item test set (Phase 1) and a quota-constructed, gold-labeled 5,000-item set (Phase 2). The stratification is diagnostic. Four zero-shot LLM judges vary by over 30 macro-F1 points across strata, and the item-level predictions of 99 Phase-1 and 32 Phase-2 competition systems reproduce the profile: discourse-level omission defeats judges and most teams alike, whereas only a minority over-flag negative controls. The judges' verdict probabilities rank items well (ROC-AUC 0.74-0.95) but are overconfident (ECE 0.04-0.29). An open competition on Alikbachan drew 222 teams and 3,566 submissions, and a single-prompt 32B judge reaches the 57th percentile. Of the 25 teams in both phases, 24 regress on Phase 2 (mean $-17.6$ points) while every zero-shot judge improves, and Phase-1 rank barely predicts Phase-2 rank (Spearman $ρ=0.35$), so a Phase-1 leaderboard alone would have crowned a different winner.

blocks.en:
In a low-resource language, a fluent answer is both the hardest kind to doubt and the most expensive kind to check.
A model that writes grammatical, register-appropriate Bengali gives no sign when it misattributes a poem or misdates
a war, and few people can verify such claims against primary sources. The de facto response to each newly
characterized failure is a new benchmark, a practice whose tacit premise is that such experts are plentiful. Most of
the world’s languages lack them ( Joshi et al., 2020 ) . Spent one dataset at a time, a small pool of experts yields
isolated resources with incompatible schemas, labels and protocols, and claims about overall progress grow harder to
trust ( Dehghani et al., 2021 ; Raji et al., 2021 ) .

We argue for consolidation over enumeration. If one resource is stratified along dimensions that cut across failure
modes, a newly identified phenomenon enters as another cell rather than another dataset. Benchmark and diagnostic
then dovetail: because every item carries its category metadata, one evaluation run reports where a system fails as
well as how well it scores. The axes themselves are not specific to Bengali. Cultural distance from a model’s
dominant pretraining distribution, task type and an explicit hallucination taxonomy could serve wherever annotators
are scarce, although the bands and corpora must be instantiated locally.

would predict. Alikbachan ( , ‘mirage of language’) crosses three axes: a human-validated, three-level

independently sourced phases

of 5,000 items, of which 1,500 are public.

blocks.en:
A resource’s authors cannot settle the consolidation argument with their own evaluations, so we test it externally. Alikbachan is the foundation of an open research competition on Kaggle, with a public leaderboard phase followed by an
in-person final for the top teams. Its complete submission history is a litmus test for the argument: it shows
whether one stratified resource concentrates effort that would otherwise fragment, and whether a second stratified
phase catches what a leaderboard alone cannot. We make four contributions. (1) We design a stratification for annotator-constrained languages that crosses cultural distance, task type
and hallucination family, and we document how both phases were built, labeled and independently audited
( § 4 ). (2) We show that the stratification is diagnostic. A judge’s macro-F1 varies by more than 30 points across
strata, and the item-level predictions of 99 Phase-1 and 32 Phase-2 competition systems reproduce the profile,
including a blind spot for discourse-level omission that judges and most teams share ( § 6 ). (3) We analyze the complete submission history of a 222-team competition and, through the 25 teams that entered
both phases, expose a generalization gap that neither phase reveals alone ( § 6.3 ). (4) We distill an independent audit into curation lessons for low-resource benchmarks ( § 5 ).

blocks.en:
Hallucination detection. Detectors fall into three broad families: consistency-based methods that sample
several generations and flag disagreement ( Manakul et al., 2023 ) ; evidence-grounded methods that check a
response against a reference through entailment or question answering ( Fabbri et al., 2022 ; Min et al., 2023 ) ;
and supervised classifiers trained on labeled faithful and hallucinated pairs ( Li et al., 2023 ) . LLMs also
serve directly as judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , as our baselines do; we additionally measure how well calibrated
their verdicts are, a property long studied for neural classifiers ( Guo et al., 2017 ) . Alikbachan serves all these
families ( § 6.1 ).

blocks.en: 3 The Case Against Fragmentation
blocks.zh: 3 防止分裂案

blocks.en:
A newly identified failure, such as a model substituting a Western officeholder for a Bangladeshi one, usually
prompts a targeted dataset. In Bengali this is costly. A small pool of experts must verify every item against
government documents, statutes, curricula and literary or historical sources, and single-purpose benchmarks drawn from
it duplicate effort and yield hard-to-compare results. We propose to spend the same effort on one framework instead
and state the desiderata it must meet. (i) Axes that cut across failure modes, so that a new failure enters as a new combination of labels rather than
a new dataset. Alikbachan uses cultural distance, task type and a hallucination taxonomy ( §§ 4.3 and 4.4 ). (ii) Item-level metadata, so that one evaluation run reports where a system fails as well as how well it scores
( § 6.2 ). (iii) A second, independently constructed phase, so that overfitting to a public leaderboard becomes visible
( § 6.3 ). (iv) An independent audit that separates construction defects from model errors ( § 5 ). Internal evaluation alone cannot show that such a framework works at scale. If one well-stratified resource can
absorb broad participation without fragmenting into task-specific benchmarks, its value should persist across
independently built systems, and the open competition in § 6.3 tests exactly that.

blocks.en: 4.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 4.1 任务定义

blocks.en:
Each item is a triple ( c , p , r ) (c,p,r) of an optional context c c (a passage, or the token [NULL] ), a Bengali prompt p p and a candidate response r r . The task is to predict y ∈ { 0 , 1 } y\in\{0,1\} , where y = 1 y=1 marks a faithful response and y = 0 y=0 a hallucinated one, i.e. one with fabricated, unsupported or factually incorrect content. With a null context the

blocks.en: 4.3 Cultural-Distance Bands

blocks.en:
The central organizing axis is a three-level cultural-distance band. C0 ( globally stable ) covers
culture-independent facts in science, geography or mathematics, such as the boiling point of water, and serves as the
control band. C1 ( culturally situated ) covers answers that are specific to Bangladesh or differ from a
globally dominant default, such as Bengali literary authorship, Liberation War dates, national monuments and regional
administration; it hosts the headline phenomenon of fluent but locally wrong output. C2 ( contested or
time-sensitive ) covers current officeholders and revised statistics, where a hallucination must be told apart from
outdated knowledge. Phase 2 fixes the band sizes at 750, 3,500 and 750 items. In Phase 1 the bands were assigned after
harvesting through a human-validated protocol (2,014, 483 and 19 items; § C ).

blocks.en:
Phase 2 spans six task types: short- and long-form open-book QA ( short-ob-qa , long-ob-qa ), both
context-grounded; short-form closed-book QA ( short-cb-qa ); summarization; Bengali–English translation; and
adversarial probes built on false premises, prompt injections, counterfactual contexts or instruction constraints
( adversarial ). Phase 1 distinguishes only closed-book from context-grounded QA, and with no separate
translation or long-form clusters it is best read as a short-answer QA benchmark.

blocks.en: 5 Curation Lessons: A Cautionary Tale
blocks.zh: 5 总结经验教训:小心报道

blocks.en:
A binary faithful/hallucinated label suits scoring but collapses four evidential states: Supported (the
evidence justifies the response), Refuted (a necessary claim contradicts it), Not Entailed (required
support is absent) and Malformed (missing or corrupted content prevents judgment). The audit
( § 4.5 ) recorded the four-way state before projecting it onto the binary label and reviewed the band
and domain assignments. Its lessons reach beyond Alikbachan .

(一) 反驳(一项必要索赔与答复相矛盾),
缺少支持)和不规范(缺少或损坏的内容妨碍判断)。 审计
(§4.5)在投影到二进制标签之前记录了四向状态,并审查了波段
和域分配。 它的教训超越了阿里巴昌。

Table 1: The independent audit condensed into a seven-layer item contract: for each layer, the pitfall the audit found
in released items and the check a curator should run. Layers are ordered by where adjudication should stop, since an
item that fails one layer cannot be judged on the layers below it; § D gives the full tables.

Bands define the verification an item needs. A C0 item can still be malformed by wrong notation, units or
polarity; a culturally plausible C1 response can attach a correct fact to the wrong entity; and two C2 values can both
be right under different reference dates. Band membership therefore says how an item must be checked, and passing
that check is a separate matter. Table 1 condenses the audit into a seven-layer contract.

blocks.en:
Most contextual errors break a relation. The commonest contextual failures reuse the context’s vocabulary but
assign it to the wrong entity, role, date, jurisdiction or comparison: role substitution, jurisdiction transfer,
near-date selection. Lexical overlap cannot catch them. The audit instead records an answer-slot signature, a
statement of what a correct answer must be (its type, entity, relation, jurisdiction, time, ordinal, polarity, unit
and precision), which the response and its supporting span must satisfy together.

转让给错误的实体、角色、日期、管辖权或比较:角色替换、管辖权转让、
近日期选择 。 表面重叠无法抓住它们。 审计记录的是答录槽签名,a

反应及其支持期限必须共同满足。

blocks.en:
Some apparent hallucinations are construction defects. Input-side defects, such as a multiple-choice stem that
refers to dropped options or an ambiguous OCR reading, can make a faithful response look hallucinated. So can source
or time defects, such as a copied answer key with an upstream error, or a stale snapshot. Such items belong in a
repair queue before evaluation.
blocks.zh:
有些明显的幻觉是建筑缺陷. 输入侧缺陷,例如多选择干
指被丢弃的选项或模棱两可的OCR读物,可以使忠实的反应看起来产生幻觉. 源头也可以
或时间缺陷,如带有上游错误的复制的回答键,或 stale shapt. 此类物项属于
评估前的修补队列。

blocks.en:
Linguistic validity belongs in the taxonomy. Antonymy, synonymy, idiom interpretation, register and
compounding are distinct operations that items can conflate, and the audit found topically related terms wrongly
accepted as satisfying a lexical relation. We folded these cases into Family C rather than a separate resource, so a
newly found failure became new taxonomy cells, as § 3 anticipates. The audit further recommends
keeping clean and perturbed variants, recording the four-way state before the binary projection, and asking
adjudicators to state why the nearest alternative fails; these practices carry over to other low-resource languages.

语言有效性属于分类学. 安东尼、同义词、平庸解释、登记和
复合是项目可以合并的不同业务,审计发现与主题有关的术语是错误的
被接受为满足了一种词汇关系。 我们把这些案子整理成C家 而不是单独的资源 所以
如第3节所预期,新发现的失败成为新的分类细胞。 审计进一步建议:
在二进制投影之前记录四向状态,
裁决者应说明最近的替代办法为何失败;这些做法将延续到其他资源匮乏的语言。

What the release supports. Every released item carries context , prompt_bn , response_bn and label . Phase-1 items add task_type , and Phase-2 items add task_type , cultural_band , family , failure_mode , provenance , source and an English rationale for the label. Table 3 maps each family of detectors to the fields it can
use. Evidence-grounded verifiers need only the context and the response. Consistency-based detectors can resample
answers to the prompt, although the model that wrote each response is not identified. Supervised detectors can train
on the labels, split and analyze errors by stratum, and take the rationales as auxiliary supervision. Our judge scripts

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Consolidation buys diagnosis as well as economy. The obvious benefit of one stratified framework over many
narrow benchmarks is a lower annotation bill in a language with few annotators. The diagnosis in § 6.2 shows a second: because each item carries its strata, one Phase-2 run reveals both how good a system is and where it
fails, at no cost beyond the stratification itself. The omission blind spot, the hardness of C2 and TigerLLM-9B-it’s
trade-off all surfaced from the same run. Separate single-task benchmarks could approximate this only if they shared
compatible labels and schemas, a coordination that is easy to envisage and, as § 3 argues, rare in
low-resource ecosystems.
blocks.zh:
综合既能赢得诊断,又能赢得经济。 一个分层框架比许多框架的明显好处
狭义的基准是低调的注解法案,用语言写,很少有注解者. 第6.2节中的诊断显示第二个:由于每个物品都带有其层层,一个阶段-2的运行显示一个系统有多好以及它在哪里
失败了,没有付出任何代价 超越分层本身。 忽略盲点、C2硬度和TigerLLM-9B硬度
取舍都从同一跑道浮出水面 单独的单一任务基准只有在共享的情况下才能大致确定
相互兼容的标签和计划,这种协调是易于设想的,并且正如第3节所指出,在下述情况下是罕见的:
低资源生态系统。

blocks.en:
A leaderboard is a lower bound on what stratification can reveal. The generalization gap is our clearest
evidence: a Phase-1-only competition would have crowned a different winner ( § 6.3 ). The
juxtaposition with the judges is instructive, since models tuned on neither phase improve where the leaderboard’s
systems decline, which makes those declines prima facie evidence of overfitting to the leaderboard. Three alternative
readings deserve weight. Phase 2 was scored once on a held-out fold, so teams could not iterate against feedback, and
part of the decline may reflect that missing signal rather than missing robustness; the phases differ in
construction, so their scores are not strictly commensurable; and with 25 teams we cannot isolate overfitting as the
sole cause. Every reading leaves the practical point intact. Phase-1 performance does carry signal, since 12 teams
lose less than 0.10, but its rank association with Phase 2 is weak, with a confidence interval that includes zero.
That suggests a salutary rule for languages that can afford only one or two benchmark iterations: make the second
one stratified and independently built.

What practitioners should carry away. Three habits follow from the results. Report error counts beside
macro-F1 on near-single-class strata, where a single false flag can halve the score. Read a judge’s verdict
probabilities as a ranking until they are calibrated, since every judge we tested is overconfident. And before
trusting a detector’s leaderboard score, test it on items it was not tuned against, such as the held-out Phase-2 split.

What four zero-shot judges do and do not show. Four off-the-shelf models of 8B–32B parameters, one prompt each,
are specific baselines, not stand-ins for frontier closed models or fine-tuned detectors. Their value is twofold: they
show that the stratification discriminates, and they anchor the percentile comparison, since a single-prompt 32B judge
that matches the median of 222 purpose-built systems says more than any label of strong or weak. Nor is Bengali
adaptation a panacea. Over its base model, TigerLLM-9B-it gained calibration and parametric strength but lost
context-grounded skill, a trade-off visible only in the stratified readout. Finally, we instantiate the axes only for
Bengali, and their transfer to other annotator-constrained languages remains to be tested.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Alikbachan suggests that where annotators are scarce, hallucination evaluation advances less through a new benchmark for
each failure mode than through one resource that shows how failures are structured. Bengali is a microcosm of the
predicament, a confluence of fluent output, few verifiers and errors that a global default makes plausible. Crossing
cultural distance, task type and a 32-mode taxonomy turned a single evaluation run into a diagnostic readout. It found
judges that rank items well yet are overconfident, a blind spot for discourse-level omission shared by judges and most
competition teams, and, across two phases, a leaderboard that would have crowned a different winner, which portends
trouble for any benchmark that is tested only once. None of these findings needed a new dataset; each lay quiescent in
strata the benchmark already carried. The held-out Phase-2 split and the released scorer now offer the same readout
to every system that follows. A language with few annotators cannot afford a benchmark for every way a model
can fail; it can afford one that shows where each model does.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Theory-authored items risk confirming their own taxonomy. About two-thirds of the Phase-2 items (3,250) are
written against target failure modes and labeled by construction, so the taxonomy partly shapes the evidence used to
evaluate it. The 1,750 theory-confirmed items and the taxonomy-blind competition systems limit this circularity
without removing it.

The audit checked a sample. Band membership states what verification an item needs, not that it passed, and
the binary label projects a four-way state onto one bit, so Malformed items are scored rather than
quarantined. The audit overturned 24 of 500 sampled labels (4.8%); the released labels largely hold, but some
residual noise should be expected. Both teams were undergraduate volunteers, and one annotation team built both
phases. The Phase-1 C2 band is small ( n = 19 n=19 of 2,516), so its figures are only suggestive; the finding that C2 is the
hardest band rests on the Phase-2 gold labels ( n = 750 n=750 ).

blocks.en:
Scope of the empirical evidence. We ran one zero-shot configuration per model, with no prompt sweep, no
fine-tuned detector and no frontier closed model. Item-level predictions were available for 32 of the 222 teams and
for 99 of the top 100, all selected on Phase-1 score, so the replications sample stronger-than-median systems. Only
1,500 of the 5,000 Phase-2 items are public; the remaining 3,500 are held out for blind evaluation, so third parties
cannot yet reproduce full-set numbers. One team’s prediction file reported a raw verdict without converting it to the 1=faithful convention, which made a competent system look miscalibrated until our own check caught it. No
reported number depends on that file, but anyone re-scoring third-party predictions should rule out such polarity
errors first.

经验证据的范围。 我们运行了一个零镜头配置每个模型, 没有即时扫描,没有

无法复制完整设置的数字。 一个团队的预测文件报道了一个原始的判断,而没有将其转换成1=忠实的大会,这使得一个胜任的系统看起来有误校准,直到我们自己的支票抓到它. 没有
报告的数字取决于该文件,但任何人重新评分第三方的预测应排除这种极性
错误先。

blocks.en:
The generalization gap admits other readings. Phase 2 was organizer-scored on a held-out fold and differs from
Phase 1 in construction, task mix and label balance, and with 25 teams we do not claim to have isolated overfitting
as the cause ( § 7 ).

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Data and rights. The Phase-1 responses come from LLMs and human writers, and Phase-2 items are built from
public Bangladeshi sources; neither intentionally contains personal information. Items name public figures only in
their public roles, which the C1 and C2 bands require, and the audit removed items whose falsehoods targeted
individuals or groups rather than facts. Released items are short excerpts or derived question–response pairs rather
than redistributed documents: statutes and government publications are public instruments, encyclopedic content is
attributed under its share-alike terms, and web text is used under its terms of use. The data are released under
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and we will honor removal requests for any item whose provenance is contested. Every corpus, model and
benchmark we build on is cited at first mention.

blocks.en:
Content. The benchmark necessarily contains fabricated Bengali text, adversarial probes and prompt injections.
This content is the object of study and every item carries a label, but generators should not be trained on its
hallucinated responses without filtering.

该内容是研究对象,每件物品都带有标签,但发电机不应接受关于它的训练。
幻觉反应而不过滤.

blocks.en:
People. Annotation and auditing were done by two teams of five undergraduate volunteers, who were not paid. The
work involved no intervention on human subjects and no personal data: annotators worked on public documents and model
outputs, and competitors took part voluntarily under published contest terms, so the protocol was deemed exempt from
ethics-board review. The competition data are public leaderboard scores and team names, and we name no individual
participant.

道德操守委员会审查。 比赛数据是公开的领队得分和球队名 我们不点名
参与者。

blocks.en:
Use. The C1 band surfaces a representational harm, the overwriting of locally correct knowledge by globally
dominant defaults, and should be read as an equity signal as well as a metric. A high Alikbachan score certifies detection
of the enumerated failure modes only. Given the omission blind spot and the over-skepticism some systems show on
negative controls ( § 6.2 ), a strong aggregate score alone does not license deploying a detector as a
safety filter for Bengali generation.
